SELECT COUNT(order_item_id) AS total_order_line_items
FROM order_items;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM customers;

SELECT AVG(payment_value) AS average_payment_value
FROM order_payments;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) AS distinct_product_categories
FROM products;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 5;

SELECT SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight_value
FROM order_items;

SELECT MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS earliest_order_purchase_timestamp
FROM orders;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_city = 'Rio de Janeiro' AND c.customer_state = 'RJ';

SELECT AVG(order_items.price) AS average_price
FROM order_items
JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id
WHERE products.product_category_name = 'cama_mesa_banho';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_item_id) AS distinct_order_items_sold_by_mg_sellers
FROM sellers s
JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE s.seller_state = 'MG';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) 
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND r.review_score = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND p.payment_type = 'boleto';

SELECT SUM(order_items.price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items
JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id
WHERE products.product_category_name = 'informatica_acessorios';

SELECT COUNT(o.order_id)
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_state = 'BA'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS distinct_customers_with_canceled_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'canceled';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_items.order_id)
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id
WHERE products.product_category_name IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS distinct_sellers
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name = 'utilidades_domesticas';
